title: AI solved the scarcity of code. What scarcity comes next?
summary: The evolution of artificial intelligence is reshaping software delivery, emphasizing enhanced decision-making over traditional methods. With an increase in organizational capacity, attention will turn toward delivering business value and quality outcomes. To manage the intricacies of AI-generated results, companies need to implement effective governance frameworks. By aligning technology investments with tangible benefits, organizations can maximize resource efficiency and turn software surplus into significant achievements.
